desc: Compute prefix distinct counts pref[0..N-1] using a boolean array.
Compute suffix distinct counts suf[0..N] (with suf[N]=0) by iterating backwards.
Implement a segment tree with lazy propagation supporting range add and range max query.
Initialize segment tree with pref[i] values.
Initialize last occurrence array for values 1..N to -1.
Iterate m from 1 to N-2 (middle end index):
For each m, get v = A[m], find prev = last_occ[v].
Update segment tree: add 1 to range [max(prev, 0), m-1].
Compute candidate = max_val + suf[m+1], update answer.
